title: Working Session — Coaty, Architecture & Partnership
format: In-person working session (~3 hrs, bagels & coffee)
statusLabel: Site shipped → agent audit + partnership scoping
tldr: Three-hour in-person working session with Flint (owner of Coatary Technologies + co-owner of Peaceful Property Management). Three goals: (1) hand off the Coatary website code for Top Rock to manage, (2) show off "Coaty" — a Claude-powered product-selection agent Flint built solo in ~30 hours, and (3) scope a longer partnership starting with a Peaceful Maintenance website. The marketing site Top Rock shipped is static (Astro on Vercel); Coaty turns Coatary into a web application, so the big theme was architecting ahead so new surfaces (PO calculator, knowledge base, e-commerce) don't force rewrites. Austin walked Flint through the "second brain" concept (organized markdown for LLMs; Obsidian; migrate SharePoint → Google Drive for Claude's native connector). They explored AI-augmenting Peaceful's ops (humans as "agent managers"), agreed to build a social media agent for Coatary first (then Peaceful), and adopted Flint's Ideate → Design → Build → Operate → Delegate framework. Partnership shape: Top Rock builds + trains Flint/Emilia to self-maintain in Claude Code; Coatary is the test bed; pricing left open (flat retainer TBD). Immediate next steps: Flint adds Austin to the Coaty repo, Austin audits it and sets Flint up on Claude Code.
